PublicationService.approve: async approve(body,{ownerId}) -> fingerprinted server approval with manifest and request
PublicationService.resume: async resume(intentId,{ownerId}) -> current intent; schedules same-identity recovery
PublicationService.state: state(approvalId) -> approval or latest intent with manifest

repairs.result: Synchronous snapshot comparison rereads episode, workflow, channel, run/review, render job, candidate assets, rights and provenance after asset/export awaits. A second comparison runs after all beforeSend promises immediately before transport dispatch; intervening edits fail409. The persisted approval itself is also compared. Approval creation, upload chunks and completion retain current-state checks.

Stale approval permits observation of its saved video ID or a zero-byte status query of its saved session. Completed-session queries retain the returned video ID and perform owner readback. Stale recovery performs no insert, media transfer or visibility update and never completes the edited project. State exposes approvalStatus:stale, phase:stale_approval and observed privacyStatus; unavailable observations remain unknown. Owner checks and retry intervals remain enforced.

Each validated local intent ID uses its own publication_<intentId> encrypted PrivateRuntime record. The shared read-modify-write document is removed without a legacy shim. Existing privateQueue shutdown handling, atomic pre-insert claim, session-before-bytes persistence and saved remote identity recovery remain in place. No PrivateRuntime/schema expansion.
